description: MLIT delineates industrial estates and standalone factory sites with areas of at least ten hectares. The reference date is 27 March 2009. The polygons were compiled from industrial-location surveys, industrial-land guides, prefectural materials and national mapping. Documented fields identify the site, administrative area and whether it is coastal or inland. Industrial-estate fields include the developer, completion year, developed and unused areas, zoning, number of resident companies and selected company names. Standalone factory sites have separate industry attributes. The polygons provide a historical representation of industrial facilities for hazard-exposure and infrastructure-dependency simulation. They do not describe smaller sites, current production, equipment condition or operational capacity. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page restricts this edition to non-commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
